feature: FILM-2209 one Shorts queue per channel, oldest first: Shorts spill past the next long video, never past the daily cap, on every Nth day; late posts move the queue on in order

mutations.name: Q1 Shorts set to every 2 days post every day
Q2 a Short follows the episode's first long video anywhere, not its own channel's
mutations.pattern: waits for the episode’s long video on the Short’s own channel

mutations.name: Q3 a long video takes a time a Short holds
mutations.pattern: never gives a long video and a Short one time

mutations.name: Q4 a Short takes a time a long video holds
mutations.pattern: never gives a long video and a Short one time

mutations.name: Q5 long videos are spaced in 24-hour steps, not local days
mutations.find:
lastFull &&
        startOfLocalDay(
          addDays(
            localDate(lastFull, cadence.timezone),
            cadence.minDaysBetween,
          ),
          cadence.timezone,
        ),
mutations.pattern: keeps 20:00 every 3 days across a daylight-saving change

mutations.name: Q6 jitter moves a post to another local day
mutations.find:
onSlotDay(
      new Date(slot.getTime() + offset * MINUTE_MS),
      slot,
      cadence.timezone,
    ),
mutations.pattern: keeps jittered posts on their slot’s day and in queue order

mutations.name: Q7 jitter reorders the queue
mutations.pattern: keeps jittered posts on their slot’s day and in queue order

mutations.name: Q8 the release hides how far the Shorts queue runs past the long videos
mutations.pattern: says how far the Shorts queue runs past the last long video

mutations.name: Q9 an upload no slot fits is released anyway
mutations.pattern: refuses, saying why, an upload no slot in a year fits

mutations.name: Q10 a late post jumps the Shorts queued after it
mutations.pattern: moves it and the Shorts queued after it

mutations.name: Q11 the job sends a Short when another channel's long video is live
mutations.pattern: waits for the long video on its own channel

mutations.name: Q12 the job counts the last 24 hours, not the local day
mutations.pattern: counts the local day, not the last 24 hours

mutations.name: Q13 a re-queued held Short goes ahead of the Shorts already queued
mutations.pattern: re-queues them at the end of their channel’s queue

mutations.name: Q15 a post an earlier post of the run moved is moved again
mutations.pattern: leaves a post alone that an earlier post of the run already moved on

mutations.name: E2E Q14 a later batch's long videos go back to back over MCP
mutations.find:
lastFull &&
        startOfLocalDay(
          addDays(
            localDate(lastFull, cadence.timezone),
            cadence.minDaysBetween,
          ),
          cadence.timezone,
        ),
